desc: The Unity Tactical SPARK IR is an ultra-compact, disposable infrared marking light designed for rapid identification of personnel or equipment during night vision operations. Fully sealed and waterproof, the SPARK IR attaches easily with its integrated hook-and-loop backing, or can be paired with the optional SPARK CAGE for mounting on webbing or magnetic surfaces. Simple to operate, pressing the center of the silicone housing cycles through constant and blink IR modes. Lightweight, rugged, and reliable, the SPARK IR is an essential tool for team ID and signaling in no-light environments.
